record.hypothesis: A 10-bit 640×360 plane was divided into 16×16 tiles. If a tile's range was ≤255, it was stored as one 16-bit local minimum plus exact 8-bit offsets; wider tiles fell back to native 16-bit values. 97.4% of tiles qualified in the controlled smooth source and total payload fell 48.3%. Recovery was exact, as was a downstream integer filter. A 0/1023 checkerboard forced wide fallback for every control tile.
